known_differences.description: fsci-arrayapi implements Array API Standard 2023.12 broadcasting, reshape, transpose, and dtype promotion rules.

threats.description: Incompatible array shapes passed to broadcast_shapes or broadcast_to cause invalid stride indexing.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-arrayapi/src/broadcast.rs:6 (broadcast_shapes): validates right-aligned dimension compatibility and rejects mismatched axes with ArrayApiError::BroadcastError.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(ArrayApiError::BroadcastError) matching Array API specification.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject incompatible shapes fail-closed and record AuditAction::FailClosed in AuditLedger.

threats.description: Shape product overflow or element-count mismatch during reshape or full array allocation.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-arrayapi/src/backend.rs:102 (reshape): checks checked_mul element counts and rejects element-count mismatches before allocation.
threats.strict_mode_response: Return Err(ArrayApiError::InvalidShape) when element counts differ.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject overflow or mismatched shape fail-closed with audit event.

threats.description: Lossy or non-finite scalar conversions during astype casting across numeric dtypes.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-arrayapi/src/backend.rs:90 (astype): validates target dtype promotion rules and checks finiteness in Hardened mode.
threats.strict_mode_response: Follow standard IEEE / Rust numeric cast semantics.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject non-finite values when casting to integer dtypes and emit FailClosed audit event.

threats.description: Out-of-bounds slice indices or negative step slicing diverging between Strict clamping and Hardened rejection.
threats.mitigation: Defended in crates/fsci-arrayapi/src/audit.rs:93 (record_fail_closed): enforces explicit Strict clamping vs Hardened fail-closed bounds checking on slice descriptors.
threats.strict_mode_response: Clamp slice bounds to [0, dim] matching Python/NumPy slice semantics.
threats.hardened_mode_response: Reject out-of-bounds slice indices fail-closed and emit FailClosed audit entry.

fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return ArrayApiError::BroadcastError and record FailClosed in AuditLedger.
Return ArrayApiError::InvalidShape and emit FailClosed audit event.

fail_closed_policies.input_class: out-of-bounds slice bounds in Hardened mode
fail_closed_policies.strict_mode_action: Clamp to axis extent per Array API standard.

fail_closed_policies.hardened_mode_action: Return ArrayApiError::InvalidAxis and record FailClosed event.
